title: Amending the Grove Artifact requires a 1% token stake plus a public post in a designated forum category
content:
A.6.1.1.2.2.2.2.2.1.2.1.1 opens Grove's amendment process with three simultaneous requirements: the process "begins with a GROVE token holder submitting a proposal through the Powerhouse system containing a draft Artifact Edit Proposal"; the holder "must hold at least 1% of the total token supply to submit a proposal"; and "the proposal must also be posted on the Sky Forum under the 'Grove Prime' category."

The design separates **right of initiative** from **right of decision**. Voting is open to all holders, but only a 1% holder can put anything on the agenda. This filters spam and forces proposers to have skin in the game, at the cost of making the agenda a function of concentration: below 1%, a holder's only route is persuading someone larger.

Requiring the forum post *in addition to* the system submission is the transparency mechanism. A proposal cannot advance through an internal channel alone — it must exist in a public, named venue where the Operational Facilitator's response and the community's reaction are visible on the same thread.

Fixing the category ("Grove Prime") rather than leaving venue open is what makes the requirement enforceable. A proposal posted elsewhere is not merely poorly publicized; it fails a procedural requirement.
description: Proposals travel two channels at once — the Powerhouse system and the Sky Forum 'Grove Prime' category — so the threshold gates who can start governance, not merely who can vote.
